subject: The outreach gap costing you discovery calls
html:
Hey {{first_name}},


Two businesses send the same number of outreach messages this month. One books three times more discovery calls than the other. The difference isn't luck — it's personalization at speed, and that's where AI beats a person working the list by hand.


Generic outreach gets replies from about 9% of people. Personalized outreach nearly doubles that to 18%. Layer AI-driven follow-up on top of that personalization, and booking rates climb another 30–40% — while cost per booked call drops by roughly 54%. Same list, same effort on your end, more calls on your calendar.
